tei:div.tei:p: (da)༄༅/ /dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sgrub thabs bzhugs so// srid zhi kun khyab ye shes 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /thugs rje'i dbang gis khros pa'i skur ston pa/ /dpal chen rdo rje 'jigs byed la btud nas/ /de yi sgrub thabs rim par bshad par bya/ /bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgom pa la/ sngon 'gro dang / dngos gzhi dang / thun mtshams su gtor ma gtong ba'i tshul dang gsum las/ dang po la/ bsod nams kyi tshogs bsag pa dang / ye shes kyi tshogs bsag pa gnyis/ dang po la yul dag pa la brten pa'i tshogs bsag ni/ dben pa'i gnas su bcom ldan 'das kyi bris sku bshams pa'i mdun du/ chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i mchod pa lnga dang / nang mchod rdo rje dril bu rnams bshams nas/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas sngon du byas te/ rang skad cig gis dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed du gsal ba'i thugs kar nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ mthing nag las 'od 'phros pas/ bla ma dang dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed la sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥzhes pas spyan drang / de'i mdun du tshogs bsag bcu gsum bya ba la/ dang po phyag 'tshal ba ni/ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥs bla ma dang / na maḥshrī badz+ra bhai ra we bh+yaḥs rdo rje 'jigs byed la phyag bya'o/ /gnyis pa mchod pa ni/ mdun du bshams pa'i mchod pa rnams bsang sbyang byin gyis brlabs nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī badz+ra bhai ra wa sa pa ri wā ra so so'i mgor sbyar ba'i ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ pā d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ badz+ra puṣ+pe/ badz+ra dhū pe/ badz+ra ā lo ke badz+ra gan+dhe/ badz+ra nai wi d+yā āḥhūm̐ swāhās phyi mchod dang / bdud rtsi yang gtor ma bzhin byin gyis brlabs la/ rtsa sngags la 'bru gsum btags pa brjod pas nang mchod/ dur khrod rgyan gyis rnam brgyan pa'i/

/zhe sdang gshin rje'i gshed po ni/ /dngos med nam mkha' lta bu la/ /thugs rjes sprul pa'i skur ston pa'i/ /ye shes khro rgyal rab 'jigs pa/ /dud kha mun chen khyod la 'dud/ /ces pas bstod pa rnams bya'o/ /gsum pa sdig pa bshags pa ni/ bdag gis skye ba thog ma med pa nas sdig pa mi dge ba'i las bgyis pa dang / bgyid du stsal ba dang / bgyid pa la rjes su yi rang ba de dag thams cad so sor bshags par bgyi'o/ /bzhi pa skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ bla ma dang rdo rje 'jigs byed 'khor dang bcas pa la skyabs su mchi'o/ /lnga pa dam tshig dang sdom pa blang ba ni/ thun mong dang khyad par gyi dam tshig dang sdom pa rnams blang zhing bskyang bar bgyi'o/ /drug pa rjes su yi rang ba ni/ sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / nyan thos dang / so so skye bo'i dge ba'i rtsa ba la rjes su yi rang bar bgyi'o/ /bdun pa smon pa'i sems bskyed pa ni/ bdag gis 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las ma bsgral ba rnams bsgral bar bgyi'o/ /ma grol ba rnams dgrol bar bgyi'o/ /dbugs ma phyung ba rnams dbugs dbyung bar bgyi'o/ /yongs su mya ngan las ma 'das pa rnams yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bar bgyi'o/ /brgyad pa chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul ba ni/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i phyir bskul bar bgyi'o/ /dgu pa mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ 'khor ba ma stongs kyi bar du mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol bar bgyi'o/ /bcu pa 'jug pa'i sems bskyed pa ni/ bdag gi dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi bsgom bzlas la gnas par bgyi'o/ /bcu gcig pa bsngo ba ni/ bdag dang sems can thams cad dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi go 'phang thob par gyur cig sdig pa bshags pa nas bsngo ba'i bar 'di lan gsum brjod do/ /bcu gnyis pa gnang ba nod pa ni/ bla ma dang 'jigs byed kyi zhal nas de ltar bsgrubs pas lam legs pa la gnas pa yin no/

/zhes gsungs par bsam zhing ngag tu yang brjod do/ /bcu gsum pa gshegs su gsol ba ni/ oṃ sarba bid pū ra pū ra/ su ra su ra/ ā wartā ya ā wartā ya hoḥzhes pas mchod de/ oṃ badz+ra muḥs gshegs su gsol lo/ /yul ma dag pa la brten pa'i tshogs bsag ni/ tshad med bzhi bsgom mo/ /gnyis pa ye shes kyi tshogs bsag pa ni/ snang ba thams cad sems tsam du bsams la/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ zhes brjod/ sems de'ang mi dmigs par bsams la/ oṃ yo ga shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥyo ga shud+dho3haṃzhes brjod do/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gsum ste/ bdag nyid sangs rgyas su bskyed pa/ de la mchod pa bya ba/ sngags kyi bzlas pa bya ba'o/ /dang po la bzhi ste/ bsnyen pa/ nyer sgrub/ sgrub pa/ sgrub chen no/ /dang po ni/ stong pa'i ngang las yam̐ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor du ba'i mdog can/ de'i steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du yi ge dhiḥyongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid 'phags pa 'jam dpal sku mdog gser btso ma lta bu zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas pas ral gri dpung pa'i thad du 'phyar ba/ g.yon pas ut+pa la'i steng na glegs bam bsnams pa/ rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan cing / ral pa'i zur phud lnga dang ldan pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i thugs kar a las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu mtha' yas mu med pa na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'/ rig pa'i lha mo/ khro bo la sogs pa dpag tu med pa bsdus nas nyi ma la thim/ 'jam dpal zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa'ang nyi ma la thim pas/ nyi ma de'ang dpag tshad 'bum gyi tshad dang ldan pa 'od zer brgya stong 'phro bar gyur/ de las 'od zer me'i tshwa tshwa lta bu 'phros pas sdang ba'i sems can rnams tshar bcad/ nyi ma'i steng du chu las chu bur rdol ba'i tshul gyis hūm̐ nag po 'od zer lnga dang ldan pa/

de las 'od 'phros/ slar 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje nag po rtse lnga pa rwa gdengs pa 'od zer lnga dang ldan pa'i lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan par bsams la/ hūm̐ las rdo rje'i tshogs dpag tu med pa 'phros/ rab tu sdang ba'i sems can rnams rdo rje'i char gyis brdungs nas tshar bcad/ yang hūm̐ gi 'od zer las sangs rgyas la sogs pa'i sku phra mo til gyi gong bu ji snyed bsdus nas nyi ma la zhugs/ de rnams kyis sems can gyi don byas nas/ nyi ma dang bcas pa rdo rje la thim/ de lta bu'i rdo rje de yongs su gyur pa las/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor cig char du gyur pa ni/ sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes sku/ /gcig tu bsdus pa 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /thugs rjes gdug pa 'dul ba'i phyir/ /khro bor gyur pa gshin rje'i gshed/ /mdog nag rab khros 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ /dbu dgu sum cu rtsa bzhi'i phyag /bcu drug zhabs kyi g.yas rnams bskum/ /g.yon brkyang rnam par bsgyings pas bzhugs/ /rtsa zhal ma he khros pa'i gdong / /hūm̐ dang phaṭa kyi sgra chen sgrogs/ /steng zhal dmar po rgya cher bzhad/ /de steng 'jam dpal gzhon nu'i zhal/ /gser gyi mdog can cung zad khro/ /g.yas pa rwa yi phyogs kyi zhal/ /dang po sngon po mche ba gtsigs/ /gnyis pa dmar po ljags 'dril zhing / /gsum pa ser po khro gnyer can/ /g.yon pa rwa yi phyogs kyi zhal/ /dang po dkar pos rmongs par byed/ /gnyis pa dud khas rengs par byed/ /gsum pa nag pos gsod par byed/ /zhal rnams thams cad spyan gsum ldan/ /phyag g.yas rnams kyis rim bzhin du/ /gri gug 'phang mdung gtun shing dang / /chu gri rdo rje rtse gcig pa/ /dgra satwa mdung mda' lcags kyu dang / /dbyug pa kha ṭ+wāṃ 'khor lo dang / /rdo rje rtse lnga tho ba dang / /ral gri rnge'u chung rim bzhin 'dzin/ /phyag g.yon rnams kyis rim bzhin du/

/khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa dang / /mgo phub rkang pa zhags pa gzhu/ /rgyu ma dril bu lag pa dang / /ro ras skyes bu gsal shing phub/ /me thab thod tshal sdigs mdzub dang / /'phan rtse gsum dang rlung ras 'dzin/ /tha ma yi ni phyag gnyis kyis/ /glang chen pags pa gos su gyon/ /zhabs g.yas rnams kyis rim bzhin du/ /mi dang ma he glang bong bu/ /rnga mo khyi lug lce spyang mnan/ /g.yon rnams rim bzhin bya rgod dang / /'ug pa bya rog ne tso dang / /khwa dang khyung chen ri skegs bzhad/ /mnan cing zhabs rnams thams cad kyis/ /tshangs pa dbang po nye dbang po/ /drag po gzhon nu gdong drug rnams/ /bsgyel nas khas bub nyid du mnan/ /mi mgo skam po lnga lnga yis/ /khro zhal rnams kyi dbu la brgyan/ /mi mgo khrag 'dzag lnga bcu dang / /sbrul nag chun pos do shal byas/ /dbu skra ser po gyen du 'bar/ /spyan rtsa dmar po glog ltar 'khyug /liṅga dmar po gyen du langs/ /sku las sprul pa'i pho nya 'phro/ /sgeg pa dpa' ba mi sdug pa/ /dgod dang drag shul 'jigs su rung / /snying rje rngam dang zhi ba yi/ /gar dgu'i nyams dang ldan pa yis/ /ye shes me dpung dbus na bzhugs/ /de'i phyi rol du rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang pa/ gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhis mdzes par byas pa/ phyi nas rim pa bzhin dkar ser dmar ljang sngo ba'i rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa'i steng na/ pha gu dang / drwa ba dang / drwa ba phyed pa dang / mda' yab dang / pu shus brgyan cing / dbus phyur bur gyur pa'i rtse mor rdo rje nor bu'i tog gis spras pa/ nang ka ba brgyad dang ldan zhing / phyi rol 'dod yon gyi snam bu la mchod pa'i lha mos bskor ba/ nang gi lha snam shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang / dbus sngo ba/ gzhal yas khang gi phyi rol du dur khrod chen po brgyad/ phyogs skyong brgyad/ shing brgyad/ zhing skyong brgyad/

sprin brgyad/ klu brgyad/ me brgyad/ chu brgyad/ mchod rten brgyad/ grub pa thob pa'i dpa' bo dang / rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs dang / 'dre dang / ro langs dang / lce spyang la sogs pa'i tshogs kyis yongs su gang ba'i phyi rol du srung ba'i 'khor lo ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba dang bcas pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ rang gi spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po bsam mo/ /gsum pa ni/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'jigs byed rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor la sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba spyan drangs la/ chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod kyis mchod nas/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥs dbyer med du bstim mo/ /bzhi pa ni/ slar yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas/ dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs la/ sngar bzhin mchod nas/ oṃ a bhi ṣiñca tu māṃ sarba ta thā ga ta/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis oṃ badz+rī bha wa ā bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan par bsam mo/ /gnyis pa de la mchod pa bya ba la/ sngags kyi mchod pa/ phyi'i mchod pa/ 'dod yon gyi mchod pa/ nang gi mchod pa/ bstod pa'i mchod pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rtsa sngags/ snying po/ nye snying gsum lan gcig brjod do/ /gnyis pa ni/ tshogs zhing gi skabs ltar chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod kyis mchod do/ /gsum pa ni/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta rū pa kā ma gu ṇa badz+ra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐ zhes sogs lnga phyag rgya dang bcas pas mchod do/ /bzhi pa ni/ rtsa sngags brjod de nang mchod gtor ro/ /lnga pa ni/ dur khrod rgyan gyis rnam brgyan pa/ /sogs kyis bstod do/ /gsum pa sngags kyi bzlas pa bya ba ni/

snying gar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ mthing nag la yi ge bcu pas g.yas skor du bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros pas sems can gyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la mchod pa sna tshogs kyis mchod nas/ de dag gi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes 'od zer gyi rnam par bsdus nas snying ga'i yi ge rnams la thim pas sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad sbyangs shing / sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi byin rlabs zhugs par bsams la/ oṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭ+rīḥwi kri tā na na hūm̐ phaṭa ces pa ci nus bzla'o/ /de nas hūm̐ dang yig 'bru rnams mi dmigs par byas te/ dbus su ya la mtha' skor du yi ge bdun pas bskor ba sogs dmigs pa sngar bzhin byas te/ oṃ ya mān+ta ka hūm̐ phaṭa ci nus bzla'o/ /yang yig 'bru rnams mi dmigs par byas te/ dbus su ma la mtha' skor du yi ge so gnyis pas bskor ba'i dmigs pa sogs gong bzhin byas nas/ oṃ ya ma rā dza/ sa do me ya/ ya me do ru/ da yo da ya/ ya da yo ne/ ra yak+ṣe ya/ yak+ṣe yats+tsha/ nīr mā ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces ci nus bzla/ sngags kyi 'od zer gyi kha dog ni zhi ba la dkar po/ rgyas pa la ser po/ dbang la dmar po/ drag po la nag por bsam mo/ /bzlas pa'i yul phreng ba ni/ bzlas pa la 'jug pa'i sngon du bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las phreng rdog re re bzhin pad nyi'i steng du bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'jigs byed zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin par bskyed/ sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab/ ye shes pa bcug dbang bskur zhing rigs kyi bdag pos rgyas gdab/ mchod bstod zhu ba las/ phreng rdog re re yang mi mgo rlon pa khrag 'dzag par bsams la sngags bzla'o/ /mjug tu sngar ltar mchod pa lngas mchod nas/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros/ snod bcud thams cad la phog pas 'od zer gyi rang bzhin du byas te srung ba'i 'khor lo la thim/

de dur khrod brgyad la/ de gzhal yas khang la/ de gdan rnams la/ gdan rnams rim gyis srog chags rnams la/ de rnams zhabs tha dad la/ zhabs lhag ma rnams rim gyis rtsa ba'i zhabs gnyis la/ phyag lhag ma rnams rim gyis rtsa ba'i phyag gnyis la/ zhal lhag ma rnams rtsa ba'i zhal la thim ste/ rang rdo rje 'jigs byed zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa ma he'i gdong pa can du bsams te/ thun mtshams kyi bya ba rnams la 'jug go /gsum pa thun mtshams su gtor ma gtong ba'i tshul ni/ mdun du gtor ma gnyis bshams pa la/ nang mchod chu chang gis sbyang / med na chu gtsang mas sbyangs la/ yi ge sum cu rtsa gnyis pas bsang / swa bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yam̐ las rlung / ram̐ las me'i steng du a las thod pa dkar po yangs shing rgya che ba/ de'i nang du shar du go las ba glang gi sha lhor ku las khyi'i sha nub tu da las rta'i sha byang du ha las glang po che'i sha dbus su na las mi'i sha de rnams kyi steng du/ shar du bi las dri chen/ dbus su mu las dri chu/ nub tu shu las byang sems/ byang du ma las klad pa/ lhor ra las rak+ta/ de rnams kyi steng du dbus su hūm̐ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes/ shar du oṃ me long lta bu'i ye shes/ byang du kham̐ bya ba grub pa'i ye shes/ nub tu dz+rīṃ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/ lhor trām̐ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ de dag gi steng gi nam mkhar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la oṃ yig dkar po mgo thur du bltas pa 'phyang ba/ zla ba'i steng du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje lte bar zla ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ hūm̐ las 'od zer 'og tu 'phros pas rlung g.yos/ me sbar nas thod pa'i nang gi rdzas rnams bskol zhing zhu ba'i rlangs pa oṃ dang / sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba'i hūm̐ la phog pas/ de dag las bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'dzag yang hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros te/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi thod pa gang ba dpag tu med pa bkug

mdun gyi thod pa la thod pa thim/ bdud rtsi la bdud rtsi thim/ sna tshogs rdo rje zla ba oṃ dang bcas pa thod pa'i nang du lhung ba 'od du zhu nas sngar gyi bdud rtsi rnams dang gnyis su med par gyur te kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs par bsams la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes lan gsum brjod/ de nas gtor mgron spyan 'dren pa ni/ rang rdo rje 'jigs byed du gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'jigs byed/ g.yon du smyon pa 'jigs byed bka' nod pa dang / mtha' skor du dur khrod kyi bdag po rnams dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥzhes pas spyan drangs la/ badz+ra bhe ra wa a gra ṭiṭha ṭiṭha badz+ra zhes dang / ut+man ḍa bhai ra wa a gra ṭiṭha ṭiṭha zhes dang / sa swa ti a dhi pa ti a gra ṭiṭha ṭiṭha zhes pas brtan par bzhugs su gsol la/ de rnams kyi ljags kyi 'od zer gyis gtor ma gsol bar bsams te/ bcom ldan 'das la rtsa sngags kyi rjes su/ oṃ bhai ra wa gṛh+ṇe daṃ ba liṃ swāhā zhes dang / smyon pa 'jigs byed la/ oṃ ut+man+ḍa la bhai ra wa ya ba liṃ gṛh+na gṛh+na ma ma kar+ya sad+ya ya swā hā/ zhes dang / dur khrod brgyad la/ aṣ+ṭa sa swā na tiṣ+ṭha bhu ta sa sa na rak+ṣan ta sarba gṛh+na daṃ ba liṃ/ ma ma sarba kar+ya sad+ya ya swā hā/ zhes pa rnams lan gsum gsum brjod do/ /de nas phyi mchod dang nang mchod kyis mchod/ bstod pas bstod/ phrin las gzhol/ yi ge brgya pa brjod cing mgron gshegs su gsol lo/ /'jam dbyangs khros chen rgyal po'i sgrub pa'i thabs/ /gsal bar bgyis pa'i bsod nams gang thob des/ /bdag dang mkha' mnyam 'gro ba ma lus pa/ /'jam dpal go 'phang myur du thob par shog /bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sgrub pa'i thabs 'di ni dpal sa skya pa chen po'i dgongs pa ji lta ba bzhin du rje btsun bla ma mus pa chen po'i zhabs rdul spyi bos blangs pa shākya'i dge slong bsod nams seng ges sde snod 'dzin pa du mas bskul ba'i ngor dpal ngam rings kyi chos grwa chen por sbyar ba'o/

/'di'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / 'phags pa 'jam dpal/ sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs/ mar me mdzad bzang po/ grub chen dpal 'dzin/ rje btsun nā ro ta pa/ as+d+yul badz+ra/ bha ro haṃ thung / mal lo tsā ba blo gros grags pa/ rje sa skya pa chen po/ rje btsun bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan/ gan pa ston dar/ gan pa so ston/ gan pa chos rgyal/ gan pa rin rgyal/ chos rje bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ mkhan chen byang chub dpal bzang po/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ rje btsun kun dga' bzang po/ chos rje dkon mchog rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ des bdag bsod nams seng ge la'o// //dge'o// ༄༅/ /spros med rgyun gyi rnal 'byor bzhugs/ /gang zhig rtog na 'jam dbyangs ye shes kyi/ /nyi ma snying gi dkyil na gsal gyur pa/ /shin tu spros med ye shes la btud nas/ /de yi nyams len tshul bzhin bshad par bya/ /'dir bcom ldan 'das gshin rje'i gshed kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob cing / dam tshig dang sdom par ldan pa shin tu spros med kyi byin rlabs dang / khrid thob pa'i rnal 'byor pas rgyun du nyams su len tshul ni stan bde ba la rdo rje'i skyil krung la sogs pa rnam snang gi chos bdun dang ldan pas skyabs 'gro dang sems bskyed sngon du song nas/ mdun gyi nam mkhar seng ges bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri sna tshogs pad+ma dang / nyi ma dang / ma he dmar po'i steng na rtsa ba'i bla ma 'jam pa'i dbyangs gshin rje'i gshed kyi rnam pa can/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ g.yas 'jig rten gsum 'dul ba'i dbyug pa 'phyar ba'i tshul gyis 'dzin cing / g.yon bdud bzhi'i khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa thugs kar 'dzin pa/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ zhal che ba bzhi gtsigs shing / skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/

klu chen po brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ zhabs g.yas bskum zhing g.yon brkyang ba'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ de'i pang na yum ro langs ma sku mdog dmar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ de'i mtha' skor du bla ma brgyud pa dang / yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dang / sangs rgyas byang sems/ 'phags pa nyan thos/ rang sangs rgyas/ chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs bcas mngon sum du bzhugs par dmigs/ de'i mtha' skor du rigs drug gi sems can rnams kyang gshin rje'i gshed kyi rnam pas 'khod par bsam/ bla ma'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas bla ma brgyud pa/ yi dam lha tshogs sangs rgyas byang sems/ chos skyong srung ma rnams spyan drangs nas gnyis su med par thim/ de nas gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid nas/ /slob dpon la ni bdag skyabs mchi/ /zhes pa'i bar tshigs rkang drug dang / gtso bo lha mor bcas pa yi/ /lha rnams la yang phyag 'tshal lo/ /khyod zhabs pad+mo spangs nas ni/ /bdag la gnas su skyabs ma mchis/ /khyod kyi thugs rje'i byin rlabs kyis/ /da lta nyid du bka' drin mdzod/ /oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐ nas/ thog mtha' 'dra ba la puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ya/ shab+da'i bar gyis phyi mchod dbul/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod dbul/ bdag gis dgra thams cad dpal ldan bla ma dam pa la dbul bar bgyi'o/ /gnyen thams cad༞ bar ma'i sems can thams cad༞ bdag tu gzung ba'i yo byad kyi dngos po thams cad dbul bar bgyi'o/ /zhes brjod/ de nas lag pa g.yas pas ral gri rno ngar dang ldan pa gzung bar bsams nas/ rang gi thod pa bcad de mdun du mi mgo'i sgyed bu gsum gyi steng du bkan nas gzhag de nas lag pa g.yon pa bcad de dum bur gtubs/ thod pa'i nang du bskyur/ de bzhin du rkang pa g.yon/ khog smad/ khog stod/ nang khrol rnams dum bur gtubs nas thod pa'i nang du bskyur/

mthar lag pa g.yas pa ral gri dang bcas pa'ang thod pa'i nang du bskyur nas/ rang sems rlung gi bzhon pa dang bcas pa rdzogs rim gyi gshin rje'i gshed kyi skur bsams te/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gsum gyis ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor byin gyis brlab/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo bla ma dam pas bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ bdag gi bsam pa mkhyen par mdzad du gsol/ bdag la thugs rjes gzung du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas mdun gyi thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba mang du chad de rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhal du blugs te/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ mang du brjod/ de nas brgyud pa'i bla ma nas chos skyong srung ma'i bar rang rang gi thugs bzhed dang mthun pa'i mchod pa sna tshogs kyis mchod par bsams nas oṃ āḥhūm̐ brjod/ de bzhin du thod pa'i bdud rtsi las rigs drug gi sems can gyi dgos 'dod thams cad yid bzhin du skong / khyad par du bdag la rbod gtong byed pa'i lha 'dre rnams la rang rang gi bsam pa dang mthun pa'i longs spyod kyis tshim par bsams nas rang gnas su dengs par bsam/ chos skyong srung ma nas yar rim pa bzhin bsdus nas rtsa ba'i bla ma la thim/ de nas sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi'o/ /zhes pas bla ma'i thugs dang rang sems dbyer med/ chos la skyabs su mchi'o/ /zhes pas bla ma'i gsung dang rang gi ngag dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o/ /zhes pas rang gi lus dang bla ma'i sku/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo bla ma dam pa la skyabs su mchi'o/ /zhes pas bla ma'i sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las dang bcas pa dang rang gi lus ngag yid gsum bya ba dang bcas pa dbyer med du gyur par bsams la/ rang sems nam mkha' la du ba yal ba bzhin phyal de song bas rang sems/ nam mkha'/ chos dbyings/ bde ba rnams dbyer med pa'i ngang la 'dzin pa gang yang lhod de/ sing nge bar mnyam par gzhag go

/de nas rnam rtog langs na rnam rtog 'od gsal gyi rnal 'byor bsgom ste/ phyi yul la 'phro ba'i rnam rtog thams cad bu ga dgu nas snying gar 'dus te mar me'i rtse mo lta bu dmar nag pa mthe bong gi tshad tsam zhig lus kyi nang du yar hril mar hril byed par bsam/ de nas snying dkar nag gi mtshams su bu ga gcig bye nas rgyangs te 'thon/ rgya mtsho'i mthar song bar bsam/ lus gogs po de las kyi rlung gis ded nas bde ba can gyi 'jig rten gyi khams su sangs rgyas 'od dpag med kyi zhabs drung du gzhag de nas sngar gyi rnam rtog de je srab je srab tu song nas nam mkha'i khams thams cad khyab ste/ rang sems dang / rnam rtog dang / nam mkha' dbyer med pa'i ngang la gzhag mjug tu/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /'jam dbyangs ye shes 'grub gyur nas/ /'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa/ /de yi sa la 'god par shog /ces sogs bsngo ba smon lam bya'o/ /tshul 'di shes ldan rnam rgyal legs ma dang / /dad ldan tshe dbang dkon mchog skyabs gnyis kyis/ /tshul bzhin bskul nas bsod nams seng ge yis/ /sbyar ba'i dge bas 'gro kun sangs rgyas shog/ //dge'o// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 10 go bo rab 'byams pa/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sgrub thabs/ spros med rgyun gyi rnal 'byor/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 11
